plain: Strong public blame, or a court's sentence of guilt.

webster.text: The act of condemning; the judicial act of declaring one guilty, and dooming him to punishment.

example.quote: No man condemned to dye shall be put to death within fower dayes next after his condemnation, unles the Court see spetiall cause to the contrary, or in case of martiall law, nor shall the body of any man so put to death be unburied 12 howers unlesse it be in case of Anatomie.
